purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Potiskum, Nigeria.
assessment: YOGIS is evidenced as the local Yobe geographic-information/land-administration custodian. Official Yobe budget records reference Damaturu–Potiskum master-plan and cadastral-mapping work. The public YOGIS property-management route is login-gated; no anonymous parcel geometry, safe native ID, schema, CRS, or citywide coverage was verified.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custodian verified: Yobe State Geographic Information Service (YOGIS), supported by its official property portal and Yobe government agency/budget records. This is not evidence that parcel geometry is publicly downloadable.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official YOGIS property-management portal. Anonymous GET returned an HTML user-login form; no public map/API configuration or parcel response was available before authentication.

Official Yobe State budget-performance report identifies YOGIS and references development of the Damaturu–Potiskum master plan and cadastral mapping. It is administrative evidence, not an open feature service.
Official Yobe State ease-of-doing-business portal page linking YOGIS documents. No anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the page result.
Official Yobe revenue-code page lists YOGIS as a state agency. It confirms agency identity but provides no parcel geometry.
Official National Library of Nigeria repository record for a Federal Surveys Potiskum topographic map. It is cartographic context, not cadastral parcel geometry.
